what: PreCompact hook bug: pre-compact-save.sh exits with code 0 (line 31), so it NEVER actually blocks compaction despite outputting {"decision":"block"} in JSON. Exit code is what matters for blocking, not the JSON content. Fix: use exit 2 for true blocking, with a two-phase flag pattern (compact-pending-{sid}.txt) to avoid infinite loop — first trigger blocks (agent saves), second trigger allows compaction through.
why: PreCompact was supposed to force the agent to call aide_remember before context loss, but exit 0 means compaction proceeds immediately. The agent sees the blocking text but can't act on it because compaction already started. This is why no aide_remember calls were made during /compact.
